pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-01.png with Read and looked at it before reading any other document. The image loaded and was readable. It shows 3 panels: a wide top tier, a tall bottom-left panel and a tall bottom-right panel. There are grey placeholder boxes labelled ananya and meera. No order numbers or guide lines appear.
pages.observation: My natural reading order was P1 -> P2 -> P3. P1 has the caption 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' and a small ananya placeholder. P2 has two balloons, both read as Meera's: 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' then 'I wish everything were easier to manage!'. The left balloon is read first. Its tail is long and ends in empty space just left of and above Meera's box rather than on her, but she is the only person in the panel. P3 has Ananya saying 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.', with a clear tail to her, and Meera sits small at lower left. The exchange reads naturally as a complaint followed by the doctor's answer. Issues: (1) Meera's role is never shown or stated (receptionist? staff?), so a first reader does not know who she is relative to Ananya. (2) P1 is a large establishing panel with only a caption and one tiny figure. In P2 and P3 all text and figures sit in the top half, leaving the bottom halves of both tall panels empty, which makes the page feel unbalanced. The layout needs a staging or size rethink rather than just filling the space. (3) The first balloon's tail does not end on Meera.
